subject.title: [Bug]: 6.x state migration leaves channel conversation-store SQLite empty (0 bytes) — orphans references, breaks proactive (Bot Framework) sends (MS Teams)

question: Should maintainers resolve this issue through the linked MS Teams migration guard now, or require broader recovery or packaged-upgrade proof first?
rationale: The issue is a real upgrade regression candidate, but the active fix changes persisted migration archive behavior and is already represented by an open PR that needs maintainer judgment.

options.title: Review linked migration guard
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98862 as the canonical fix path and close this issue only after it lands or is replaced.

options.title: Request packaged upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted release-to-patched upgrade or doctor transcript before accepting the migration behavior change.

options.title: Broaden recovery scope
options.body: Require the fix path to also handle already archived legacy sources or partial imports before the issue can close.

recommendation.title: Review linked migration guard
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98862 as the canonical fix path and close this issue only after it lands or is replaced.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history connection to the MS Teams SQLite store and doctor migration behavior.
